b650aorus.identityEvidence: Owner listing explicitly names B650 AORUS ELITE AX Rev 1.2 and links this specific board photo album. Actual model marking and original board layout visually confirmed. Same-album Device Manager photograph shows Realtek 8852CE WiFi 6E PCI-E NIC, matching revision 1.2 in the GIGABYTE official manual, printed page 8; earlier revisions specify AMD RZ616 or Intel AX210. The test photograph also shows CPU-Z model B650 AORUS ELITE AX and BIOS FB3g. The last physical PCB revision digit is obscured by a connector; no claim is made that it was visually read. Identity relies on the primary owner listing plus coherent actual-board testing evidence, rather than retailer stock photography.
